verdict.rationale: Proton Pass generates TOTP codes, so reading them on a smartwatch is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions a smartwatch, Wear OS, or Apple Watch app or companion. The documented surfaces are only mobile apps, browser extensions, desktop apps, the web app and the CLI, so the axis applies but there is no evidence the product delivers it.

support.subject: As an everyday user, I can read my codes from my smartwatch without pulling out my phone
